shortlist: First establish one master common pad with the three source-confirmed wood/meat/cash empty and stocked states.
Keep resource-type extension as icon/content variants of that same footprint. New pictograms are explicitly proposed and derived from the reviewed resources, not invented canonical gameplay symbols.
Raw species cuts share the generic meat pad; species identity remains in stored item silhouette and external sheet labeling. This avoids inventing ten separate species storage mechanics.

Timber planks/firewood can share timber; prepared/cooked/dried fish can share fish; prepared/cooked/dried meat and bread-like cooked_food can use a proposed food group. Grouping is visual organization only, not a recipe rule.
Use enough visible stock to demonstrate occupation/occlusion; HIGH STOCK remains visual density, not numeric capacity.
Do not build the separate structural timber/mineral/meat/ingot enclosures unless the root contract explicitly adds them.
common_empty_template: storage_empty uses observed wood symbol and no physical stock
grouping_semantics: The15 representative sheets cover shared physical pad vocabulary for33 existing resource concepts. No shared inventory, storage custody, mixing eligibility, capacities or mechanics are asserted.
classification_clarification: Only generic wood, meat and money are direct video storage types. Species-specific contents and other resource variants are proposals based on existing reviewed resource concepts; no native meshes have been delivered.
